evidence.text: This accounts for the amount of renewable (wind) power that is provided to UCC by our contracted supplier.

Calculated by our contracted supplier Sustineo to GHG Protocol standards and ISO -. A top down method was used to assess expenditure data and identify hotspots. A bottom up methodology was then employed using primary data. UCC also submits data to the Sustainable Energy Authority of Ireland to report on the University's Climate Mandate to government. This is updated annually.
In the University's Western Gateway Building, discharge water from the Ground Source Heat Pump (GSHP) is used to fill water storage tanks used in the flushing of toilets

Non-hazardous waste data is collected on behalf of UCC, by the University's contracted waste provider, Panda. Data on Construction and Demolition waste is provided by the contracted construction company.
